background_music_flow_inquiry_descriptio: Send us your request by direct message on Instagram.
background_music_flow_meeting_descriptio: We talk with you about the details of your request.
background_music_flow_editing_descriptio: We edit the music based on our consultation.
background_music_flow_delivery_descripti: We send you the edited music as a digital file.
background_music_price_note_1: The price depends on the length of the music and how much editing it needs.
background_music_price_note_2: We send you a quote before starting the work.
background_music_hero_eyebrow: We edit music for your routine
background_music_hero_summary: We build your favorite tracks into a single piece that follows your routine. Name the songs yourself, or just tell us the mood you want. We work directly with athletes and coaches.
background_music_hero_note: A direct message on Instagram reaches us fastest. Quotes are free.
background_music_points_lead: It is not only about fitting the time limit. We help from planning the structure through to later revisions.
background_music_point_1_title: Trim it to the routine time
background_music_point_1_body: We rebuild the whole structure of the piece so it fits the required time. Rather than just cutting, we join the sections so the result still sounds natural.
background_music_point_2_body: Collect only the choruses, or switch tracks between the quiet passages and the fast ones. We merge several songs into one piece that follows how your routine unfolds.
background_music_point_3_body: The cue that starts you moving, where the climax lands, the resonance after the last pose. We adjust volume and pauses so the music locks into the routine.
background_music_point_4_body: If your routine changes, we can swap sections or fine-tune the length. We tell you up front whether it counts as a rebuild.
background_music_works_lead: These pieces were used at real competitions. Tap a name to open the YouTube video of that routine.
background_music_works_count: We have edited {count} pieces so far.
background_music_price_lead: The price depends on the length of the piece and how much editing it needs. Talk to us first; we start work only after you have the quote.
background_music_flow_lead: Four steps take you from the first message to delivery. You can come back and rethink things at any step.
background_music_contact_lead: You do not need to have chosen the music yet. Even just your competition date is enough to start. Say hello first.
background_music_contact_note: This is a one-person operation, so a reply can take a few days. Quotes are free.
background_music_cross_link_decorating_b: We finish stick, club, ring and rope to match your team colors and the image of your routine. From {price} per hour of work.
background_music_cross_link_coaching_bod: From building a routine to the basics. Online, or in person at your venue.
